_note: Route-to-human (specialist) service categories (founder-approved spec §2.8). For these the agent NEVER quotes: it acknowledges once, captures the listed structured details, hands off to a specialist (a pending task + human follow-up), and stops making commitments. Distinct from UNSUPPORTED (politely declined, e.g. haircut) and from the sell-directly specialty items in §2.7 (shoes/bags/carpets/curtains) which the agent quotes after a photo. B2B/commercial is handled separately by services/b2b.py + the escalation rules. Terms are matched case-insensitively as substrings on a normalised message; keep them specific so ordinary garment/laundry requests are never swept up.

HOME_CLEANING.label: villa / home / deep cleaning
HOME_CLEANING.acknowledgement: We can absolutely help with that — home and deep cleaning is handled by our specialist team. Let me pass your details to them and they'll follow up shortly.

WEDDING_DRESS.label: wedding dress
WEDDING_DRESS.acknowledgement: Wedding dresses are handled by our specialist garment team so we can care for them properly. Let me take a few details and have them follow up with you.

LUXURY_BESPOKE.label: luxury / bespoke garment care
LUXURY_BESPOKE.acknowledgement: That's a specialist piece, so our luxury garment-care team will look after it. Let me capture a few details and have them reach out.
